name: What tools are needed for rocker light switch installation?

mainEntity.name: What tools are needed for rocker light switch installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Basic tools required for a standard rocker light switch installation typically include a Phillips-head screwdriver, a flat-head screwdriver, wire strippers, and a voltage tester to ensure the power is off. For more involved installations, an electrician might also use pliers, electrical tape, and a drywall saw if a new electrical box needs to be installed or existing wiring adjusted. Safety glasses and gloves are also advisable. Always ensure power is disconnected at the breaker before starting any electrical work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Essential tools for rocker light switch installation include screwdrivers, wire strippers, and a voltage tester. Additional tools like pliers or a drywall saw may be needed for complex jobs.
